items.html: And we will return to the first matter: at that time, before man was created, the conclusion of Assiyah was at the end of the sixth Sefira of the present world of Yetzirah; and all the four lower [Sefirot] of Yetzirah and all the ten Sefirot of the present Assiyah, which are fourteen Sefirot, were vacant; and there was the dwelling place for all the Klipot.
